enforcedBy: the naming gate, which refuses a filename whose last segment before the extension is an undeclared tag or differs from its folder's tag

check.population: every filename whose concern slot holds the tag, and the folder holding each such file
check.freshness: a verdict stands until a file carrying the tag is created, moved or renamed, or the declared vocabulary changes
check.refusal: the lint run fails a file whose tag is undeclared or disagrees with its folder
check.observation: each filename parsed by position against the declared concern vocabulary
check.evidence: fires-and-accepts: a suite lints a file whose tag is undeclared and one whose tag differs from its folder, and passes a conforming file
check.authority: the declared concern vocabulary, which a filename's tag and its folder conform to

records.name: Service Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that offers a stateful capability other code calls, filed in a services folder.

records.name: Controller Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that receives an external request and routes it to the code that answers it, filed in a controllers folder.

records.name: Coordinator Tag

distinctFrom.reason: A coordinator owns a lifecycle and drives its collaborators, while a service offers a stateful capability that others call.
A coordinator drives collaborators through a lifecycle, while a processor applies one operation to each item passing through.

records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that owns a lifecycle and drives the collaborators it depends on, filed in a coordinators folder.

records.name: Orchestrator Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that sequences several independent steps into one run and decides what happens when one fails, filed in an orchestrators folder.

records.name: Mediator Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file through which peers communicate so that none of them refers to another directly, filed in a mediators folder.

records.name: Dispatcher Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that selects which handler receives each incoming message, filed in a dispatchers folder.

records.name: Workflow Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a multi-step process with its transitions and outcomes, filed in a workflows folder.

records.name: Job Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a unit of work run outside the request that asked for it, filed in a jobs folder.

records.name: Task Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one named piece of work a runner can schedule and report on, filed in a tasks folder.

records.name: Stage Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one ordered phase of a larger run, filed in a stages folder.

records.name: Step Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that performs one advance of a process, filed in a steps folder.

records.name: State Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds the current condition of something the system tracks, filed in a state folder.

records.name: State-Machine Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a set of states and the allowed transitions between them, filed in a state-machines folder.

records.name: Transition Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one move from a state to the next with its guard, filed in a transitions folder.

records.name: Store Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds state and controls how it is read and changed, filed in a stores folder.

records.name: Reducer Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that computes the next state from the current state and an action, filed in a reducers folder.

records.name: Mutation Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one permitted change to held state, filed in a mutations folder.

records.name: Selector Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that derives a value from held state for its readers, filed in a selectors folder.

records.name: Observer Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that watches a subject and reacts when it changes, filed in an observers folder.

records.name: Listener Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that is registered for one kind of event and runs when it arrives, filed in a listeners folder.

records.name: Emitter Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that produces events or output for others to receive, filed in an emitters folder.

records.name: Signal Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a reactive value whose readers update when it changes, filed in a signals folder.

records.name: Publisher Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that sends messages to a topic without knowing who receives them, filed in a publishers folder.

records.name: Subscriber Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that receives the messages of a topic it has joined, filed in a subscribers folder.

records.name: Subscription Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines the binding between a subscriber and what it receives, including how it ends, filed in a subscriptions folder.

records.name: Context Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that carries the ambient values a unit of work reads without passing them through every call, filed in a context folder.

records.name: Capability Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that grants or describes one ability a component may use, filed in a capabilities folder.

records.name: Propagation Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that carries context across a boundary such as a thread or a network call, filed in a propagation folder.

records.name: Correlation Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that assigns and reads the identifiers tying related operations together, filed in a correlation folder.

records.name: Ambient-Context Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds values available implicitly for the length of one operation, filed in an ambient-context folder.

records.name: Viewmodel Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that shapes state for one view and exposes the actions that view offers, filed in a viewmodels folder.

records.name: Presenter Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that formats data for a passive view and handles that view's input, filed in a presenters folder.

records.name: Navigation Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines how a participant moves between views, filed in a navigation folder.

records.name: Input Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that reads device input and turns it into actions the system understands, filed in an input folder.

records.name: Gesture Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that recognizes a pattern of pointer or touch movement as one intent, filed in a gestures folder.

records.name: Behavior Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that decides what an agent does next from what it perceives, filed in a behaviors folder.

records.name: Heuristic Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that scores options by an approximate rule where an exact answer costs too much, filed in a heuristics folder.

records.name: Intent Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that represents what an agent means to do before any action carries it out, filed in an intents folder.

records.name: Actuator Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that turns an agent's decision into an effect on the world, filed in an actuators folder.

records.name: Classifier Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that assigns an input to one of a set of categories, filed in a classifiers folder.

records.name: Learner Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that adjusts an agent's parameters from the outcomes it observes, filed in a learners folder.
